NOTE: git diff palimnex/experience.py is exactly four inserted lines (numstat 4 0): FEEDBACK_PAYLOAD_SCHEMAS frozenset of the two feedback schema strings, and current_eligible returns False when payload.schema is in that set. experience.py does not import palimnex.feedback. git diff palimnex/core.py is 56 insertions: feedback-record, feedback-correct, feedback-withdraw parser and ledger-command wiring, read-only feedback-report, and a lazy from . import feedback in main. No other core.py hunks. git diff --stat palimnex lists only CHANGELOG.md, core.py and experience.py among tracked palimnex files.

NOTE: git diff --exit-code is empty for palimnex/retrieval.py, palimnex/durable.py, palimnex/semantic.py, palimnex/cache_v3.py, palimnex/ontology_influence.py and palimnex/schemas/memory-event.v1.schema.json. The only production import of palimnex.feedback is the CLI branch in core.py.

NOTE: Independent /tmp probe (temporary project and ledger): with no feedback, assemble_context, build_capsule and retrieve_sources match committed current_eligible (HEAD logic monkeypatched). After record, correction, withdrawal and a second record, those three outputs stay byte-identical; ordinary fact text remains in context; palimnex:retrieval-feedback is absent from context and capsule; ledger.recall(include_history=True) still returns feedback fact and correction events. CLI query canary exits 1 with stderr {"status": "error", "error": "retrieval feedback refused: query_privacy_refused at query", "cache_consulted": false} and no canary echo. CLI record and report succeed with historical_only and retrieval_influence false.

NOTE: palimnex.tests.test_feedback_cli 6/6 passed, including test_context_and_capsule_never_include_feedback. artifacts/ontology/phase-5/integration/r16-negative-control.log shows that test FAIL when R16 is disabled and OK when enabled. Focused run also passed test_feedback 13/13, test_feedback_schemas 8/8, test_experience 25/25. mypy: Success: no issues found in 22 source files. pyproject.toml only adds palimnex/feedback.py to the strict files list.

NOTE: artifacts/ontology/phase-5/integration/gate.log has twelve steps, each exit=0, including Ran 550 tests in 208.217s OK, mypy 22 source files, index, validate --deep, evaluate --limit 5, ledger-status with events 0, evaluate-ontology-shadow, ontology-status, status, and the standard gate. Receipt command results match those log lines, the experience.py numstat, the production-files unchanged exit, the six CLI tests, and both ownership audits.

NOTE: ownership-audit.lanes.json status clean with no unowned path. ownership-audit.integration.json status violation exit 1; the nine listed paths match the receipt result string exactly and are coordinator records (briefs/FEEDBACK_SPEC.md, manifest.json, reviews/, round-1 receipts, the amended integration task card, and tools/amend_integration_r16.py, gate.sh, write_integration_receipt.py). NOTE: CHANGELOG says context never reads feedback. assemble_context still calls ledger.recall, which can load matching feedback rows into the candidate window, then current_eligible drops them from results so the context and capsule documents stay unchanged. Capsule is covered by R16 and the CLI test but is not named in the CHANGELOG list. palimnex recall and hot-events still list feedback as historical_only ledger history, as R16 and the implementation receipt disclose.

NOTE: R16 is recorded as a coordinator decision for owner confirmation in clarification-R16.md and the implementation receipt unresolved_risks. This review validates the implementation against the R16-amended task card and does not grant owner confirmation.

source_grounding_result: Owner-run feedback-record/correct/withdraw call palimnex.feedback builders that bind locators through cache_v3.source_snapshot and MemoryLedger.append_event source evidence. R16 does not change locator admission. experience.py filters by payload schema strings only, so context and capsule never present feedback as historical_event items. Non-feedback observed events remain eligible exactly as before.
privacy_result: CLI refusals are FeedbackError (a ValueError), caught by core.main, printed as JSON on stderr, and return 1. A runtime-built AWS-key canary in --query produced query_privacy_refused at query with no canary on stdout or stderr. Parser unknown judgement raises SystemExit. scan_bytes on experience.py, core.py, test_feedback_cli.py, CHANGELOG.md, COMPATIBILITY.md and pyproject.toml found nothing. feedback-report is read-only (CLI test: ledger status counts unchanged).
retrieval_quality_result: R16 closes the round-1 context/capsule leak. With feedback absent, context, capsule and retrieve_sources match committed eligibility. With feedback present (fact, correction, revocation, then another fact), those outputs stay byte-identical and contain no feedback schema bytes, while ordinary matching history remains. retrieve_sources, explain-search, search, symbols, impact and palimnex evaluate do not import palimnex.feedback. The CLI isolation test fails when FEEDBACK_PAYLOAD_SCHEMAS is emptied (r16-negative-control.log).
compatibility_result: Additive CLI commands and payload identifiers on existing fact, correction and revocation kinds. memory-event.v1, ledger schema, retrieval.py, durable.py, semantic.py, cache_v3.py and ontology_influence.py are unchanged versus HEAD. COMPATIBILITY.md and CHANGELOG.md do not claim a new event kind or retrieval influence. Recall and hot-event projection still show feedback as ordinary historical_only ledger history, which R16 classifies as audit surfaces.
rollback_result: Revert the four palimnex/experience.py lines, the 56 palimnex/core.py lines, the COMPATIBILITY.md and CHANGELOG.md Phase 5 paragraphs, and the pyproject.toml mypy-list addition; delete palimnex/tests/test_feedback_cli.py and the integration receipt. Context and capsule would again include matching feedback facts (the round-1 blocker). No ledger migration to reverse. Temporary CLI test ledgers are discarded with their temp directories.
authority_result: feedback-record, feedback-correct and feedback-withdraw are ledger writes intended for the owner; feedback-report is read-only. Tests and this review used temporary repositories and temporary ledgers only. Approval evidence authorizes ontology_phase_5_extensions with network, git-write and live-state false. Git writes_performed false; HEAD remains 56db9e57. This review authorizes no real-ledger write, Git write, network, influence activation, or phase-5 close. R16 still awaits owner confirmation as a coordinator decision.
